commit 7c25709298edd0b441eeeb949569efa9f5924a4f
Author: pi-action-agent[bot] <355532786+pi-action-agent[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>
Date:   Thu Nov 12 03:17:36 2026 -0700

    feat: prompt templates, tool exclusion, and overrides from extensions (#56)
    
    * feat: log when an extension replaces a tool, and test overrides
    
    A tool with the name of an earlier tool replaces it, as pi's registerTool
    does. The log now says so. Tests cover wraps of tools and sections, their
    order, and replaced tools. The docs describe overrides.
    
    * feat: add exclude_tools and model_tools_hidden inputs
    
    exclude_tools disables tools completely; model_tools_hidden keeps them
    from the model but callable by other tools, such as pit's tools.*. Both
    accept * globs, are resolved after the extensions and their wraps, and
    are applied on every run, so an empty input clears an earlier setting.
    A name that matches no tool is a warning; no tools left fails the run.
    The setup line of the log now shows the tools the model gets.
    
    * feat: expand prompt templates from extensions, the project, and agent_dir
    
    A task that starts with /<name> gets the body of the template with that
    name, with pi's argument variables. Templates come from each package's
    pi.prompts (pi-durable packages too), then .pi/prompts with
    trust_project only, then <agent_dir>/prompts; the first name wins. The
    log shows the request as typed, and the thread's comment entry keeps it.
    
    * docs: show the tools and prompt templates in the workflow log section
    
    ---------
    
    Co-authored-by: pi-action-agent[bot] <355532786+pi-action-agent[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>
